info.name: Health Monitoring API v1.1
info.description:
Fit for Surgery - Health Monitoring module. Implements API reference v1.1.

Run the folders in order with the Collection Runner: 0 Login, 1 Admin setup, 2 Patient, 3 Doctor, 4 Error cases.
Each request has automatic checks (Tests tab). Select the "Health Monitoring - Local" environment first.

Dates: {{today}} and {{yesterday}} are worked out before every request in the Asia/Kolkata time zone, the seeded patients' zone.
The alert limits set in folder 1 are placeholders for testing only; real limits are pending the clinical team.

exec: // The patient's today and yesterday, in Asia/Kolkata (UTC+05:30, no daylight saving).

item.name: 0. Login (Firebase)
item.description: Gets a Firebase ID token for each test user and stores it in the environment. Tokens last 1 hour; run this folder again after that.

item.name: 1. Admin setup
item.description: Admin sets the alert limits the patient and doctor steps rely on.

exec: pm.test('limit saved for PAIN, high 6', () => { pm.expect(t.type).to.eql('PAIN'); pm.expect(t.high).to.eql(6); });

request.description: Placeholder limit for testing only. Real limits are pending the clinical team (v1.1 Open questions).

exec: pm.test('limit is per BP field', () => { pm.expect(t.type).to.eql('BP'); pm.expect(t.field).to.eql('systolic'); });
pm.test('PAIN limit is listed', () => pm.expect(res.data.map(t => t.type)).to.include('PAIN'));

item.name: 2. Patient
item.description: Patient fills in today's log, raises a PAIN alert, and reads logs and trends.

exec: pm.test('BP has a range per field', () => { pm.expect(bp.fields.systolic).to.have.property('minValid'); pm.expect(bp.fields.diastolic).to.have.property('maxValid'); });

item.name: Clear PAIN (so the run can be repeated)

request.description: Sending null clears a value. Done first so the save below always counts as a change and raises an alert, even on a second run the same day.

item.name: Save today's readings (pain 7 raises an alert)

exec: pm.test('12 parameters logged = 13 of 14 fields (sugar skipped)', () => pm.expect(log.filledCount).to.eql(13));

item.name: Retry the same save (must change nothing)

request.description: v1.1 Duplicates and retries: re-sending the same body is a no-op, so no new alert.

exec: pm.test('today is in the list', () => pm.expect(res.data.map(l => l.date)).to.include(pm.variables.get('today')));
pm.test('7 labels and 7 values', () => { pm.expect(t.labels.length).to.eql(7); pm.expect(t.values.length).to.eql(7); });
pm.test('separate systolic and diastolic series', () => { pm.expect(t.systolic.length).to.eql(30); pm.expect(t.diastolic.length).to.eql(30); });

item.name: 3. Doctor
item.description: Doctor finds the alert, views the patient, and acknowledges it.

exec: pm.test("the patient's PAIN alert is in the queue", () => pm.expect(alert).to.be.an('object'));
pm.test('alert shows patient name and current value', () => { pm.expect(alert.patient.name).to.be.a('string'); pm.expect(alert.currentValue).to.eql({ num: 7 }); });
pm.test('note saved', () => pm.expect(a.note).to.eql('Called patient, pain settled after rest'));
pm.test('the alert is now acknowledged', () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().data.map(a => a.id)).to.include(pm.environment.get('alertId')));

item.name: 4. Error cases
item.description: Each request should fail with the documented status and error code.

item.name: 404 - doctor opens a patient not linked to them
409 - save for a day that is not today

exec: pm.test('detail code is OUT_OF_RANGE', () => pm.expect((body.details || []).map(d => d.code)).to.include('OUT_OF_RANGE'));

item.name: 400 - pain must be a whole number

exec: pm.test('detail code is WRONG_SHAPE', () => pm.expect((body.details || []).map(d => d.code)).to.include('WRONG_SHAPE'));
pm.test('detail code is EMPTY_READINGS', () => pm.expect((body.details || []).map(d => d.code)).to.include('EMPTY_READINGS'));
pm.test('detail code is UNKNOWN_TYPE', () => pm.expect((body.details || []).map(d => d.code)).to.include('UNKNOWN_TYPE'));

item.name: 400 - alert limit with low above high
400 - acknowledge with a status other than ACKNOWLEDGED
